definition: No position, no entries, no strategy fees, no strategy-driven drawdown; capital preserved except opportunity cost.
purpose: Minimum conservative hurdle after failed holdout and failed dry-run references.
comparison_use: Future candidate must beat this after fees and drawdown in predeclared validation.
limitation: Can underperform buy-and-hold in bull markets due opportunity cost.

definition: Passive BTC exposure over same validation window, with no active strategy timing.
purpose: Opportunity-cost and passive exposure reference for BTC-relevant strategies.
expected_strategy_drawdown: market exposure drawdown, not strategy activity drawdown
comparison_use: Candidate should justify active trading through risk-adjusted improvement versus passive BTC exposure when BTC-relevant.
limitation: Does not replace no-trade; bull-market passive gains do not validate active strategy edge.

definition: Parked Long1-only candidate from chronological 70/30 holdout.
purpose: Failed active-strategy reference that new candidates must not merely repeat.
expected_active_pnl: holdout net PnL -69.89; PF 0.9832; BTCUSDT net PnL -50.21; BTCUSDT PF 0.8475

definition: Operational dry-run references: D2 roughly -51.92 USDT over about 7 days; D6 early stop -103.78 USDT.
